FN-5UQTM3-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 207
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Senator Randy Price
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 04/13/2023
Senate Bill 207 as introduced creates an income tax refund check-off, beginning in the 2024
tax year, for the State Parks Division of the Department of Conservation and Natural Resources,
the Department of Mental Health, and the Alabama Medicaid Agency. Based on contributions to
the current voluntary income check-off programs in fiscal year 2022, each agency could receive
an estimated $10,500 annually from the provisions of this bill.
This bill would increase the administrative obligations of the Department of Revenue (DOR) by
a small, undetermined amount, which would be offset by the allowed cost of administration of
up to 5% of collections that may be retained by DOR.
